# Dental Wellness — AECS Layout, Brookefield, Bangalore

> Dental Wellness is a premium multi-specialty dental clinic located in AECS Layout, Brookefield, Bangalore, India. Founded in 2008 by Dr. Shobha Nangrani (MDS, Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics).

## About

- Phone: +91 99805 67389
- Email: dentalwellnessbangalore@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon–Sat 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM & 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM
